frame: OpenAlex legacy concepts, levels 2-5 (levels 0-1 are ancestor-only rows)

three_class_agreement.note: the second model (gpt-4.1-mini) was shown to flip the narrower/broader direction under the original label names, so the 5-class kappa understates agreement; 3-class merges narrower and broader

recommendation: For cross-group O5 comparisons use a Wikipedia/Wikidata-only variant (sources wikipedia_en, wikidata), because domain taxonomies and curated lists cover groups unevenly.
